digest.component_or_area: plan review attestation and currency validation
propositions: No-file-impact reviews currently invalidate on any base-SHA change, causing 21% of re-reviews (307/1457) to re-execute on byte-identical material; this over-invalidation must be scoped to the read-set and inherited blast-radius paths.

The read-set must be normalized from distinct_fetches, filtering to read_file tool only, resolving to repo-relative POSIX paths, dropping non-existent files and outside-repo targets, and deduping before signing into the manifest.

The read-set is fed into the ADR-0002 dependency-hash check only when file_impact is empty, container poison is absent, and a read-set was recorded; blast-radius globs expand to individual hashes plus a membership digest to detect addition/deletion.

Glob patterns in blast radius (criteria_routing.json, rebar.toml, criteria/**, reviewers/**, gates/**) must be hashed via membership digest at attestation time and consistently at verification time, including the inline hash in compute_validity's default loop.
A tampered read-set, unrecorded fetch telemetry, pre-change attestations without the field, or glob expansion failure must each fall back to invalidate-on-any-change (whole-HEAD re-review).
The currency basis (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) must be recorded in the signed manifest and reported by plan_review_status and rebar review-plan --status in both text and JSON.
